### Source Methodology & Verification Notes
- **MOIT PDP8 (2023):** Vietnam’s official Power Development Plan VIII. Annexes 1–3 list all approved thermal projects, capacities, and timelines. Base URL: `https://moit.gov.vn` (search "Quy hoạch điện VIII" or "PDP8").
- **EVN Annual Reports & Press Releases:** Official commissioning dates, operational status, and capacity figures. Base URL: `https://en.evn.com.vn` (Reports → Annual Reports / News).
- **Global Energy Monitor (GEM) Wiki:** Independent, publicly audited tracker of global coal/gas plants. Base URL: `https://www.gem.wiki` (Vietnam Coal/Gas Trackers).
- **IEEFA Reports:** Financial & policy analysis of Vietnam’s LNG/gas transition and project delays. Base URL: `https://ieefa.org` (search "Vietnam LNG" or "Vietnam Power").
- **Data Currency:** All CODs, statuses, and capacities reflect publicly disclosed information as of mid-2024. LNG projects are highly sensitive to terminal construction, FSA signing, and global pricing; coal projects face PDP8-mandated phase-downs. For real-time tracking, cross-reference with EVN’s monthly generation reports and MOIT’s project approval bulletins.

## Goal

Produce a complete, primary-sourced reference inventory of Vietnam's past, present and future thermal generation assets (> 30MWe) structured as follows:

## Structured power plants table

Tabulate for every thermal power plant in Vietnam:

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

Where:
- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired
- Total MWe: Include units > 30MWe.
- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
- Sources: specify where in the document, include URL

Output format: Markdown.
